test_item:
Verification of Certificate Subject Field
(subject name differs from the configuration; certificate is rejected)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. SAM Dongle is inserted into the DUT
4. Configuration files are present under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/{TYPE}/cfgs/
input: Leaf certificate leaf.crt whose Subject CN differs from the configured name (wrong-subject variant of X-e)
proc:
1. Read the Subject field of the wrong-subject leaf certificate on the host
$ openssl x509 -in leaf.crt -text
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the wrong-subject leaf certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. Confirm the Cert Provider rejects the certificate
$ adb logcat -s MelcoCertProviderTest
er:
1. The openssl output shows a `Subject:` line whose CN differs from the configured name
2. The openssl command prints `SAMcert.pem: OK` on stdout, so only the Subject field differs
3. `$ adb logcat -s MelcoCertProviderTest` contains an `ERR_` entry for the subject mismatch; the exact keyword is `PENDING: DR-SEC-h log keyword`
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-CertProvider-002 Verification Criteria (correct/wrong subject branch); CertProfile r18
